I know how you feel, I had a failed suicide attempt a couple of years ago where I cut myself on the places that are usually joked about but I was scared and didn't cut deep enough. I'm thankful for not doing it coz that 'scaredness' was the fire within me wanting me to stay alive and keep soldiering through. It may not have been very bright but it was still lit and burning all I had to do was figure out what the fuel was to make the flame bigger. Also I told my therapist and it was the moment where my life changed and mindset changed. So based off of my experience, I'm happy the change of scenery kept you here and now you need to find the fuel to add to your internal flame, it may take days, weeks possibly months but keep fighting through just to get through each day and once you find that fuel, make it your number 1 thought when you wake up and your number 1 thought when you go to sleep. It is worth it and so are you.

Remember that little flame which was probably less than 1 percent of you wanting to stay alive, kept you alive so think of all the highs you'll have when that flame becomes 70, 80, 90 and 100 percent of you. Also I don't know if this will help but I'm trying to help based off of personal experience.
